page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for graphics-intensive tasks, visual computing, and artificial intelligence inference. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz across 4 physical cores and 8 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. It includes 30.0 GB of system RAM (yielding 3.75 GB per core) and integrates a dedicated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. Baseline networking provides 16 Gbps of throughput, while local storage is not bundled, necessitating network-attached block storage for persistence.

Benchmark evaluations highlight clear performance specialization. In machine learning inference workloads, the single NVIDIA A10 GPU achieves top-tier results. For a 7B-parameter language model, the system registers 2,504.89 tokens per second in prompt processing and 90.71 tokens per second during generation. Processing for 135M-parameter models scales to 9,665.83 prompt tokens per second and 456.78 generation tokens per second. Conversely, host CPU and memory operations fall within mid-range averages, reflected in a Geekbench 6 multi-core score of 5,901.0, a PassMark CPU score of 11,364.98, and large-block read bandwidth of 57.43 GB/sec.

Cost efficiency is focused around its dedicated GPU accelerator rather than raw host compute power. The 8 vCPU host allocation serves primarily as a feeder for the 24 GB NVIDIA A10, preventing CPU over-provisioning when running GPU-bound tasks. Because zero local NVMe storage is included, workloads requiring rapid local caching must consider external block storage IOPS limitations and latency tradeoffs. The ecs.gn7i-c8g1.2xlarge is optimally targeted at small to medium deep learning inference serving, video rendering pipelines, image generation, and AI-assisted cloud workstation hosting.
